Question:
Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT bs.match_id, bs.over_id, 
           SUM(bs.runs_scored) as batsman_runs,
           COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as extra_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bs.match_id = er.match_id AND bs.over_id = er.over_id AND bs.ball_id = er.ball_id
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.over_id
),
over_total AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, batsman_runs + COALESCE(extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM over_runs
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_total
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT ot.match_id, ot.over_id, ot.total_runs
    FROM over_total ot
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mr ON ot.match_id = mr.match_id AND ot.total_runs = mr.max_runs
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bs.match_id, bs.over_id, bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.over_id, bb.bowler
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(runs_conceded) as max_runs
    FROM bowler_runs
    WHERE (match_id, over_id) IN (SELECT match_id, over_id FROM max_overs)
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_max_with_match AS (
    SELECT bm.bowler, bm.max_runs, m.match_id
    FROM bowler_max bm
    JOIN bowler_runs br ON bm.bowler = br.bowler AND bm.max_runs = br.runs_conceded
    JOIN max_overs mo ON br.match_id = mo.match_id AND br.over_id = mo.over_id
